method: Count exact sparse row/column support against original descriptor variable-family identifiers. Engineering group labels are a documented support-based classification; mixed rows use priority WAN link, WAN dynamics, migration, local state, start/service.
limitations: No unique original semantic row-name provenance retained in these snapshots.
Global/network/artificial families and exact presolve lineage are outside this local census.
QoS and D0 restrictions encoded in allowed domains do not require distinct named row families.
This identifies support/row growth and does not prove causal Barrier fill-in contributions.
Columns touching multiple row families are counted separately in each family, not a partition of all variables.
